extensions.Description: Returns true when the value is a structurally valid Polish NIP (ten digits, mod-11 check digit). Makes no network call.
extensions.Name: Nip.IsValid

extensions.Description: Returns why a value is not a valid Polish NIP: VALID, EMPTY, LENGTH, NONDIGIT or CHECKSUM. Register as a text rule and set Mode = Reason. Makes no network call.
extensions.Name: Nip.Validate

extensions.Description: Checks a NIP against the Ministry of Finance VAT whitelist and writes the status, the registered name and the register's own request ID onto the instance. Attach to a button or a path -- never to step entry, a timer or a field default: each firing spends one of 100 daily lookups.
extensions.Name: FetchVatPayerData
VatStatusBadge
extensions.Description: Displays the VAT whitelist status returned by FetchVatPayerData. Display only: it cannot re-run the check.
